{{Top|leg}}
An '''Oxygen Reprocessor'''<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> or '''oxygen convertor''' was a [[Life support/Legends|life support]] device.<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> They were available for purchase in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. They generally cost three hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each.<ref name="SWS" /> They were utilized as part of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] life support system.<ref name="TDC" />
